C902.text: The staged-audio music identification model is recorded as in service, and serving remains a separate operation. The retained receipt holds {F001} measured checks. C903.text: These results should not be read as proof of improvement. Every interval is wide and each baseline figure that differs lies inside its interval. C924.text: Strengthen the evidence before changing the recipe: new sealed data first, tuning second

C925.text: First, keep the model in service but claim no proven gain over baseline. Accuracy of {F011} per cent against {F012} per cent sits inside the interval.

C926.text: Second, commission a fresh, independently labelled and sealed evaluation set, with non-music audio first. Its interval of {F031} to {F032} per cent is the weakest.
